tools.name: search_esim_plans
tools.description: Search SimAbroad eSIM plans for a trip. Pass country_code (ISO 2-letter, e.g. 'JP', or a code from list_destinations such as 'USPR') to get every plan that works there: single-country plans plus regional and global plans that cover it (see the coverage field). Or pass region for multi-country plans.

tools.name: list_destinations
tools.description: List countries and regions where SimAbroad sells eSIM plans right now, with the country_code to pass to search_esim_plans. Search accepts names, common aliases ('USA', 'UK') and codes. Countries marked multi_country_only are covered by regional or global plans only.

tools.name: get_buy_link
tools.description: Get a simabroad.com checkout link for one eSIM plan, by the id returned from search_esim_plans. Opening the link adds that exact plan to the cart and opens checkout; the traveler pays there (card, Apple Pay or Google Pay) and gets the eSIM QR code by email. Nothing is charged by calling this tool.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_buy_link · Public sink: get_buy_link.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_buy_link · Public sink: get_buy_link

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
